docs.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Application
docs.text: Welcome to the documentation for the Jigsaw Puzzle application, a web-based game for solving puzzles collaboratively in real time.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Real-time Collaboration: Solve puzzles with others in a synchronized environment.
  • Interactive Design: Drag-and-drop puzzle pieces to assemble the solution.
  • Feedback System: Receive immediate feedback on puzzle completion.

docs.title: Documentation Overview
docs.text: This guide provides: - A breakdown of application features - Detailed workflow descriptions - An outline of WebSocket interactions - Answers to common questions - Explore the sections to learn more!

docs.title: API Reference
docs.text: This section is reserved for documenting the application's API endpoints and WebSocket events.

docs.title: WebSocket Events
docs.text:
• piece_dropped: Notifies about puzzle piece movement.
  • puzzle_solved: Indicates puzzle completion.
  • puzzle_failed: Indicates incorrect assembly.

Additional details about request and response structures will be added as needed.

docs.title: FAQ
docs.text: varshithasrisai@VarshithaSriSai:docs$ cat faq.md

docs.title: How does real-time synchronization work?
docs.text: The application uses WebSocket communication to broadcast puzzle state updates to all connected participants.

docs.title: Can I play the game offline?
docs.text: Currently, the application requires an active internet connection for real-time collaboration.

docs.title: What happens if a participant disconnects?
docs.text: The puzzle state remains synchronized, and disconnected participants can rejoin to continue solving.

docs.title: How are puzzles validated?
docs.text: The application checks whether the pieces are placed in the correct positions on the grid before marking the puzzle as solved.

docs.title: Features Overview
docs.text: The Jigsaw Puzzle application provides an interactive puzzle-solving experience with the following core features:

docs.title: Real-time Collaboration
docs.text: Multiple participants can solve a puzzle simultaneously. The application uses WebSockets to synchronize progress and broadcast updates.

docs.title: Drag-and-Drop Functionality
docs.text: Participants can drag puzzle pieces and drop them onto a grid, mimicking physical puzzle assembly.

docs.title: Feedback System
docs.text: The application checks the correctness of the puzzle in real time: - Displays a success message when the puzzle is correctly assembled. - Provides helpful feedback if the assembly is incorrect.

docs.title: Dynamic Progress Updates
docs.text: Puzzle states are synchronized across all participants, ensuring a seamless collaborative experience.

docs.title: Real-time Interaction
docs.text:
The Jigsaw Puzzle application enables participants to collaborate in real time using WebSocket-based communication. Key elements include:

  • Synchronization: Updates to the puzzle state are broadcast to all connected participants.
  • Interaction: Actions such as moving puzzle pieces are reflected instantly across all clients.
  • Collaboration: Participants can work together to solve puzzles, fostering teamwork.

This ensures a responsive and engaging experience for all participants.

docs.title: Drag-and-Drop Functionality
docs.text: The drag-and-drop interface allows participants to move puzzle pieces interactively.

docs.title: Client Actions
docs.text:
1. A piece is dragged, triggering visual feedback.
  2. The piece is dropped onto a grid cell, signaling its placement.
  3. The client validates the piece's position for correctness.

docs.title: Server Actions
docs.text:
• Receives placement updates from clients.
  • Broadcasts the new state to all participants, ensuring synchronization.

docs.title: Workflow Overview
docs.text: The Jigsaw Puzzle application workflow is designed to facilitate seamless interactions between participants and the server.

docs.title: Workflow Stages
docs.text:
1. Socket Connection and Channel Join: Participants establish WebSocket connections and join the puzzle channel.
  2. Drag-and-Drop: Puzzle pieces are moved interactively on the grid.
  3. Puzzle Completion: The application validates puzzle assembly and provides feedback.
  4. WebSocket Messaging: Updates are communicated in real time to ensure synchronization.

Each stage plays a vital role in maintaining the application's functionality.

docs.title: Client Actions
docs.text:
• Validates the puzzle's correctness by comparing piece positions to the solution.
  • Triggers success or failure feedback based on the result.

docs.title: Server Actions
docs.text:
• Broadcasts puzzle completion status (success or failure) to all participants.
  • Updates the state for future interactions.

docs.text:
